projectDescription: A REST API backend for a vinyl record store, built with Node.js, Express, Prisma (PostgreSQL), and Redis, integrating Discogs, Last.fm, and YouTube for catalog data.
keyFeatures: JWT authentication with bcrypt password hashing and 7-day token expiry
Vinyl catalog browsing via Discogs API (search, recent releases, genre filtering, release details)
Album enrichment with Last.fm (history/biography) and YouTube (music video lookup)
Server-side price calculation based on release year and Discogs want/have popularity ratio
Redis caching layer with per-endpoint TTLs (1 hour to 7 days) to protect external API rate limits
Shopping cart checkout with backend price validation (client-supplied prices are ignored)
Browsing history tracking per user (capped at 10 items, FIFO eviction)
Personalized recommendations combining Last.fm similar artists, genre matching, and user history
Role-based access control with four roles: cliente, vendedor, admin, demo
Global rate limiting (100 req/min) plus stricter auth endpoint limiting (10/15 min)
